name: @swarmmachina/swm-core
description: High-performance HTTP/WebSocket server built on swm-uws
author: SwarmMachina Team

scripts.build:scripts: node --input-type=module -e "import { rmSync } from 'node:fs'; rmSync('.scripts-dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc --project tsconfig.scripts-build.json
scripts.build: pnpm build:scripts && node .scripts-dist/clean-dist.js dist && tsc --project tsconfig.build.json && node .scripts-dist/copy-public-types.js
scripts.build:test: pnpm build && node .scripts-dist/clean-dist.js .test-dist && tsc --project tsconfig.test-build.json && node .scripts-dist/copy-test-artifacts.js
scripts.build:benchmark: pnpm build && node .scripts-dist/clean-dist.js .benchmark-dist && tsc --project tsconfig.benchmark-build.json && node .scripts-dist/copy-benchmark-artifacts.js
scripts.check: prettier . --check && eslint . --ext .js,.ts,.vue && tsc --project tsconfig.json && tsc --project tsconfig.test.json && tsc --project tsconfig.benchmark.json && tsc --project tsconfig.scripts.json
scripts.test:e2e:uwebsockets-reference: pnpm build:test && node --conditions=uwebsockets-reference --test --test-skip-pattern="prefetch|req access after async boundary|async ws upgrade|public readable API" .test-dist/tests/e2e/**/*.test.js
scripts.bench:core: pnpm build:benchmark && node .benchmark-dist/benchmark/http/runner.js --test base-sync --runs 1 --warmup 10 --sample-ms 250 --v8prof true --fw core
scripts.bench:core:async: pnpm build:benchmark && node .benchmark-dist/benchmark/http/runner.js --test base-async --runs 1 --warmup 10 --sample-ms 250 --v8prof true --fw core
scripts.bench:headers:core: pnpm build:benchmark && node .benchmark-dist/benchmark/http/runner.js --test headers --runs 1 --warmup 10 --sample-ms 250 --v8prof true --fw core
scripts.bench:set-header: pnpm build:benchmark && node .benchmark-dist/benchmark/http/runner.js --test headers --fw core-set-header-append,core-set-header-array --runs 7 --warmup 2 --duration 6 --connections 100 --pipelining 10 --sample-ms 250 --order balanced --json-out benchmark/profiles/set-header/load.json
scripts.profile:set-header: pnpm build:benchmark && node .benchmark-dist/benchmark/http/runner.js --test headers --fw core-set-header-append --runs 1 --warmup 2 --duration 10 --connections 100 --pipelining 10 --sample-ms 250 --v8prof true --json-out benchmark/profiles/set-header/profile-append.json && node .benchmark-dist/benchmark/http/runner.js --test headers --fw core-set-header-array --runs 1 --warmup 2 --duration 10 --connections 100 --pipelining 10 --sample-ms 250 --v8prof true --json-out benchmark/profiles/set-header/profile-array.json
scripts.bench:headers:prepared: pnpm build:benchmark && node .benchmark-dist/benchmark/http/runner.js --test headers-prepared --runs 1 --warmup 10 --sample-ms 250 --v8prof true --fw core
scripts.bench:static:hit: pnpm build:benchmark && node .benchmark-dist/benchmark/http/runner.js --test static-cache-hit --fw core --runs 3 --warmup 2 --duration 6 --connections 100 --pipelining 10 --sample-ms 250 --v8prof true
scripts.bench:static:miss: pnpm build:benchmark && node .benchmark-dist/benchmark/http/runner.js --test static-cache-miss --fw core --runs 3 --warmup 2 --duration 6 --connections 25 --pipelining 1 --sample-ms 250 --v8prof true
scripts.bench:stream: pnpm build:benchmark && node .benchmark-dist/benchmark/http/runner.js --test stream --fw core --runs 3 --warmup 2 --duration 6 --connections 100 --pipelining 1 --sample-ms 250 --v8prof true
scripts.bench:stream:backpressure: pnpm build:benchmark && node .benchmark-dist/benchmark/http/runner.js --test stream-backpressure --fw core --runs 3 --warmup 2 --duration 6 --connections 10 --pipelining 1 --sample-ms 250 --v8prof true
scripts.bench:ws:upgrade: pnpm build:benchmark && node .benchmark-dist/benchmark/ws/upgrade.js --fw core,hyperexpress --scenario sync,async --runs 1 --warmup 1 --duration 2 --concurrency 20 --v8prof true
scripts.release:gate: pnpm check && pnpm test && pnpm test:e2e:bindings && pnpm test:e2e:binding-candidate && pnpm test:types && pnpm test:package
